description:
Outcome: Gardener applies for a coming-season plot with up to three preferences, from brief.md: First version must 1
Scope: Application with 0-3 distinct valid plots; edits while applications open; immutable initial timestamp/stable ordering sequence; duplicate submission protection and confirmation. Excludes: Guaranteed preferred plot
Acceptance: One application per verified household/season; edits preserve original queue order; closed seasons reject new writes; invalid and duplicate preferences explained
Behaviour: Accessible loading/empty/success/error states; retry never creates duplicate applications
Verification: Phone journey and tests for 0/3/4 preferences, concurrent retry, closure and preserved edit order. Prerequisites: T-002, T-003, T-005. Assumptions: Preferences optional and not guaranteed; coordinator closes applications
title: Seasonal applications
